_comment: Read-side registry for whatsapp-ingest-agent (.claude/agents/whatsapp-ingest-agent.md) and scripts/whatsapp_pull.py. Created 2026-10-29 on Albert's request: supplier groups, customer chats, staff groups and his personal number, via 2Chat. The repo is public, so NO phone number, API key or message text ever goes in this file: numbers live in .env (TWOCHAT_BUSINESS_NUMBER / TWOCHAT_PERSONAL_NUMBER) and chats are keyed by 2Chat group uuid (WAG...) or by the salted hash scripts/whatsapp_pull.py prints as chat_key. Method: methods/whatsapp-ingest.md.

channels._comment: Which connected numbers are read. sensitivity is the default for every item from that channel. personal is private with no override, ever (genuinely personal: vault CONVENTIONS, Visibility rule 4). business is private as the fail-safe until Albert decides whether staff already see these chats in the shared 2Chat inbox (open question in methods/whatsapp-ingest.md); flipping it to team is a dated vault decision.

archive._comment: Where the history Albert asks about lives. 2026-10-29: 2Chat itself, read live with scripts/whatsapp_pull.py (any window) or the 2Chat MCP connector. No copy is kept anywhere. A Make capture scenario and two private Notion archive databases were designed first and dropped the same day, because 2Chat already holds group and 1-to-1 history and copying it cost Make operations. The two Notion databases were created empty in Albert's Notion Directory and await his OK to trash. Open: how far back 2Chat keeps history; if it trims, revisit and copy only what is at risk.

chats._comment: Per-chat overrides, keyed by chat_key from the pull. kind is one of supplier | customer | project | staff | personal | other (client project groups are `project`). ghl_covered: true skips a 1-to-1 chat GHL already ingests as TYPE_WHATSAPP, so a customer is never counted twice. label is a display name only. A chat may escalate sensitivity to private, never relax it below its channel's default. Unlisted chats are classified by the agent from content and the keyword lists below.

classification._comment: Hints, not rules. The agent classifies semantically; a match here only breaks ties.

payment_request: when i can come and collect
